purpose: Explain one bounded founder-finance idea at a time with original context and visible sources.
audience: English-speaking early-stage founders who want practical finance context without investment advice.
independentReasonToFollow: The feed is a recurring original learning product even when no venture release is being supported.
originalContentPromise: At least four independently useful original explainers for every one relevant venture-support post.

repeatableFormats.name: One number
repeatableFormats.description: One founder-finance ratio explained with a worked fictional example.
repeatableFormats.sourcePlan: Use public definitions and independently composed fictional examples.

repeatableFormats.name: Decision tree
repeatableFormats.description: A short decision tree for a bounded operating finance question.
repeatableFormats.sourcePlan: Derive the tree from public accounting concepts and record sources before drafting.

expectedCadence.sourcePlan: Maintain a four-week bank of original concepts and refresh sources before approval.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Runway without false precision
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Show a new founder how scenario ranges change the answer.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Contribution margin in one example
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Use a fictional small software product instead of a finance textbook abstraction.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Fixed or variable first
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Help a bootstrapped founder classify one upcoming cost.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Cash timing versus profit
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Explain why a profitable invoice can still create a cash gap.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Choose one planning horizon
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Separate weekly survival decisions from annual planning.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: A bounded break-even check
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Use one product and state every assumption.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Discount or preserve margin
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Frame the tradeoff for an owner with limited delivery capacity.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: Three costs a launch hides
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Include owner time without pretending it is a cash expense.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: When a forecast is stale
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Give a small team observable refresh triggers.

firstOriginalConcepts.title: What not to infer from revenue
firstOriginalConcepts.audienceAngle: Protect a first-time founder from treating topline as available cash.

stopConditions: Pause if the original-content runway falls below ten approved concepts before activation.
